_comment: Landing-owned wording for the product groups: the short name and one plain line each page, menu and card uses. The manifests beside it are vendored from dpp-core and gated against drift, so they are never edited here; this file is the only place the site words a group for a general reader. Each line describes what the passport carries, taken from the fields of that group's current schema, and never states a legal obligation or a date. 'order' is the order every list on the site shows them in. 'unsold-goods' is kept out of 'order' on purpose: its own manifest says it is not a product group and imposes no passport, so it is listed separately wherever it appears.
